scientific_limitations: The quantitative conclusion concerns the top spectral edge of a noncompact two-periodic Jacobi tail, not every gap eigenvalue.
The dimerization condition a != b excludes the previously analyzed constant-tail family.
Quadratic threshold asymptotics fix the positive second boundary bond; no uniformity as that bond vanishes.
Established half-line Jacobi/Weyl methods and a closely related single-boundary SSH model may support stronger literature implications; bibliographic priority has not been independently certified.
title: Two-boundary surface thresholds and numerical-range rigidity for dimerized weighted shifts
